name: Marching Lines for Volumetric Contour Extraction
definition: A method to extract sparse linear features (contours) directly from volumetric data by tracing intersection curves between the isosurface and a 'contour surface' defined by the view direction, avoiding full volume traversal.
summary: Marching Lines extracts sparse contour lines from volumetric data by tracing intersections between an isosurface and a view-defined contour surface, offering output-sensitive performance unlike dense mesh methods.
